Main bound

Verified. Lean accepts the proof, and lean-pkg's record shows every check of this result passed (the build, and the statement comparison).

    n ≤ n * n

Note. the headline estimate

  • Not checked by any tool: that a title or note describes its Lean statement. A definition listed under Definitions checked by a person is compared by name and type only.

The full account of what each check covers and what it takes on trust is lean-pkg's trust model.

How this was checked

  • lean-pkg's claims ledger: ready, every required claim is closed by the recorded receipts; 1 of 1 required claim(s) verified (sha256:…).
  • Build check (lean-pkg gate) at commit : sorry count 0; axioms used: propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice.

  • Toolchain advisory: the build check ran on Lean leanprover/lean4:v4.32.0, which has a known soundness bug fixed in v4.34.1 (lean-v4.34.1-runtime-refcounts; lean-pkg's toolchain advisories).
